trance_quest.title: The Trance of Shroudgarde
trance_quest.description: Uncover the source of the hypnotic daze and slay the Duthka'gith High Priest inside the temple deep within the Mirrored Marsh.

objectives.description: Slay the Duthka'gith High Priest [Duthka'gith High Priest](entity:duthkagith_priest) in the Temple

chalice_quest.title: The Sacred Chalice
chalice_quest.description: Retrieve the stolen Sacred Chalice of Shroudgarde from the depths of the Sunken Spire in the Mirrored Marsh.

tribal_war_quest.title: Tribal Warfare
tribal_war_quest.description: Thin the monstrous factions inside le Gouffre Maudit to protect Shroudgarde's borders.

objectives.description: Slay Norker Scouts [Norker Scout](entity:norker_scout) in the Upper Caves
Slay Scro Raiders [Scro Raider](entity:scro_raider) in the Orcish Depths

soul_gem_quest.title: The Ghost Tower of Inverness
soul_gem_quest.description: Venture into the sunken Ghost Tower of Inverness in the southeast marsh. Descend through the levels of Air, Earth, Fire, and Water to retrieve the legendary Soul Gem.

water_temple_quest.title: The Sluice of the Tides
water_temple_quest.description: Brave the submerged halls of the Water Temple inside the Mirrored Marsh. Slay the mutated Vodyanoi Lurker, turn the Drainage Valve to drain the temple, and reclaim the Trident of the Tides.

objectives.description: Slay the [Vodyanoi Lurker](entity:vodyanoi_boss) in the Hydro-Core
Retrieve the [Trident of the Tides](item:trident_of_tides) from the Valve Room

moathouse_quest.title: The Ruined Moathouse
moathouse_quest.description: Travel along the road to Nulb, locate the ruined Moathouse, and defeat the dark cleric Lareth the Beautiful to retrieve his platinum-headed staff.

objectives.description: Defeat [Lareth the Beautiful](entity:lareth_beautiful) in the dungeons

toee_quest.title: The Temple of Elemental Evil
toee_quest.description: Descend into the heart of the Temple of Elemental Evil. Defeat the four elemental cults and banish the Demon Queen of Fungi, Zuggtmoy, back to the Abyss.

objectives.description: Defeat [Zuggtmoy, Demon Queen](entity:zuggtmoy_boss) in her Fane
